input.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.WorkingSetSize -gt 250MB } | Sort-Object WorkingSetSize -Descending | ForEach-Object { "$($_.ProcessId) $($_.Name) $([math]::Round($_.WorkingSetSize/1MB))MB $(if ($_.CommandLine) { $_.CommandLine.Substring(0,[math]::Min(120,$_.CommandLine.Length)) })" }
input.description: Find what is using memory now
